about: YouTube lane of record 003's 2026-10-07 round. Sources: the saved channel pages (ndlover, SuSinWoo, 꽝라멩, 그니), the saved query 차원의 이면 공략 and discovery searches, all in evidence/r2026-10-07/05-youtube. Frames (frames/, subs/, sheets/) were cut from downloaded videos and read one by one; cookies are identified from formation-screen art against the portrait descriptions in evidence/08-extract/youtube-frames.json and dc-4.json, and the battle bar order is formation row 1 slot 1, row 2 slot 1, row 1 slot 2, … (checked on every deck with a visible formation). Brackets are header power ÷ curated/rift-levels.json recommended_power (season 1); power_basis 'rift' means the sword figure under the player name on the in-Rift screen. Formation-screen power is noted as lobby power only. Levels and stars: levels are read off the battle bar; star tiers were not legible ('?'). Play dates come from the in-Rift countdown, assuming it counts to the season 1 end (2026-10-08 03:00 UTC); upload dates are the post dates. suggested_standing is this lane's suggestion.

posts.title_en: Season 1 Rift levels 11-20: recommended deck per boss
posts.summary_en: 그니 (Rift rank 210th-278th, blessing Lv.6) shows a deck and a full clear for every Rift level from 11 to 20 with the in-Rift header power on screen. Levels 11, 12, 14 and 17 clear in the 15% bracket (34.6%, 31.5%, 39.6%, 35.2% of recommended); 13, 15, 16, 18, 19 and 20 clear at 35% (40.2-43.1%). Lobby (formation) power is 4.67-5.02G throughout while the header climbs from 18.55G to 49.31G, i.e. 차원의 힘 growth between sessions. Every deck: captain Milk, perks 초고속 승진 + 열정페이, levelled-down supports, airborne-resist pet (복주머니) on Cool Mint/Werehound, 와사비 pet on GingerCraven.

Subtitle (levels 12, 13, 17, 18): Cool Mint and Werehound Princess have airborne skills, so the third pet becomes 복주머니 (airborne resist).
Subtitle (levels 15, 20): 와사비 pet on GingerCraven to keep the sustained debuffs up.
Intro subtitle: once the (power) is met clearing is not hard ("…맞춰진다면 클리어하는 데 어려움은 없습니다"), and the Rift lets you field more dealer cookies (딜러 쿠키를 더 많이 사용할 수 있습니다).
rift: The on-screen countdown beside the Rift icon reads 7일 8시간 at levels 11-12 and 3일 11시간 at level 20: if it counts to the season 1 end (2026-10-08 03:00 UTC), the fights were played 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-04 and uploaded 2026-10-05.
The header also shows 축복 Lv.6 (blessing), not the 차원의 힘 level; no 차원의 힘 level is on screen.
